meta.title: Low-lying electronic states of photodissociation products
meta.units: cm-1 above the lowest level of the ground state (atoms) or v=0 of the ground state (molecules)
meta.rule: dHf0(excited) = dHf0(ATcT ground entry atct_ground_id) + energy_cm1 * kJ_per_cm1. If atct_excited_id is set, ATcT TN 1.228 already lists that state: use the ATcT entry and do not add this row again. Rows with use=false are estimates, not measured T0. sys_cm1 is an allowance for a reference-level offset that was not converted (multiplet centre, hypothetical J=0 level) or, where flagged atct_gap_<cm-1>, for a gap between ATcT's value of another state of the same molecule and the Huber-Herzberg value that the conversions here do not explain (NH b 1Σ+ through H&H's singlet band combinations, the O2 band origins), to be combined in quadrature with unc_cm1; correction_cm1 is the shift already applied to a Huber-Herzberg band origin quoted from Hill-Van Vleck zero points.

meta.revised: 2026-11-11: allowances from the ATcT cross-check. NH b 1Σ+: H&H derive a 1Δ from b-X plus the singlet bands (note 24); ATcT's a 1Δ (12688.65 cm-1) with the same singlet bands puts b 99.6 cm-1 above H&H's b-X origin, so ±99.6 cm-1 is carried. O2 b, c, A, A', B: ATcT's a 1Δg lies 9.7 cm-1 above H&H's origin, so the H&H O2 origins carry ±9.7 cm-1 for the reference level (for A' combined in quadrature with its multiplet allowance).
